findings.title: Repeated equality filters lose AND semantics
findings.observed: ListingResolver.php:412 writes each native EQ to one field-keyed criteria map; :420 overwrites bundle criteria. Conflicting weight=10 AND weight=20 yields id2. A later bundle scope similarly overwrites an explicit bundle-key criterion.
findings.expected_contract: FR-002 AND-composes every filter; the implicit bundle scope narrows the same conjunction.
findings.consequence: Accepted definitions produce wrong rows and totals. This is a logical filter error; it does not independently establish unauthorized disclosure.
findings.refutation: AND is explicit FR-002; native criteria overwriting is not an intentional override rule. Exposed values can replace one declaration, but that does not authorize a second declaration to erase its peer. Identical repeated equality is harmless; incompatible repeated equality and explicit bundle conflicts have no constructor refusal.
findings.acceptance: Conflicting repeated EQ returns no rows, identical repeated EQ retains matches, filter order cannot change membership, and explicit bundle criteria cannot broaden the conjunction. Cover in-memory, SQLite and bundle-deferred paths.
